source.original_text: For natural d,q with 2q+1<d set r=q+1. Take exactly r independent standard d-dimensional Gaussian columns with their product probability measure mu. Let gamma_i be their actual physical row. Put theta_i=(i-1/2)pi/d, t_i=(1,sqrt(2)cos(theta_i),...,sqrt(2)cos(q theta_i)), R_i=norm(gamma_i)^2 and L=2r+3log(1000d). Define Y_i as inverse-d times gamma_i gamma_i-transpose tensor t_i t_i-transpose on the closed event R_i<=L, and zero outside. Every actual ordinary matrix square Y_i squared is Bochner integrable. The sum over physical rows of its actual expectations is bounded above in full PSD order by (2r(r+2)/d) times the identity matrix of size r squared. This binding stops at the uncentered bound of Ex115-117. Centered variance, weighted centered variance and matrix concentration are separate unfinished claims.

decoder_context: Fin n is the finite index set of natural numbers less than n. Natural numbers embed into real numbers in the usual way.

EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its Euclidean norm and Borel structure. WithLp.toLp 2 wraps a coordinate function as that vector and WithLp.ofLp recovers the same coordinates.

stdGaussian on finite-dimensional real Euclidean space is the centered Gaussian probability law with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the finite product measure with its product measurable structure.
Real.log is the natural logarithm and Real.sqrt the nonnegative square root. An if-expression with a real inequality uses that exact condition, including equality in a less-than-or-equal condition.

Matrix.vecMulVec u v has entry u_i times v_j. Matrix.kronecker A B has paired indices with entry A_(i,k) times B_(j,l) at ((i,j),(k,l)). Matrix multiplication is ordinary finite matrix multiplication, not entrywise multiplication. The symbol 1 is the identity matrix.

Matrix.PosSemidef A includes both Hermitian symmetry and nonnegative quadratic form for all finitely supported vectors; on a finite real index set this is ordinary symmetric positive semidefiniteness.

Matrix integrals use the complete Euclidean operator norm and the Bochner integral. Integrable means almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite extended-norm integral; it is an asserted output wherever displayed. The integral is totalized to zero when not integrable, so the explicit integrability outputs are substantive.

# Reconstructed mathematical statement

For every pair of natural numbers d and q such that 2q + 1 < d, make the following definitions. All coordinate indices are zero-based. Write J = {0,...,d−1} and I = {0,...,q}, let D = R^d and E = R^(q+1) with their Euclidean norms and Borel structures, and let Ω = I → D. Give Ω the product probability measure μ consisting of one standard Gaussian law on D for each b in I. Thus a sample ω assigns a vector ω(b) in R^d to each b in I; these vectors are independent centered Gaussian vectors with identity covariance.

Let r be the real number q+1, and define the real numbers

    L = 2r + 3 log(1000d),
    C = 2r(r+2)/d,

where log is the natural logarithm and natural-number parameters are embedded in R in scalar formulas. For each i in J, set

    θ_i = (i + 1 − 1/2)π/d = (i + 1/2)π/d,
    t_i(0) = 1,
    t_i(k) = sqrt(2) cos(kθ_i)  for k = 1,...,q.

Here sqrt(2) is the nonnegative square root; when q = 0, only the coordinate t_i(0) occurs. For ω in Ω, define the row vector x_i(ω) in E by

    x_i(ω)_b = ω(b)_i  for b in I.

Define the real matrix Y_i(ω), with both its rows and columns indexed by I × I, by

    Y_i(ω) = (1/d) (x_i(ω)x_i(ω)^T) ⊗ (t_i t_i^T)
                 if ||x_i(ω)||_2^2 ≤ L,
             0   if ||x_i(ω)||_2^2 > L.

The outer products and Kronecker product here mean exactly that, on the first branch, the entry in row (b,k) and column (c,l) is

    (1/d) x_i(ω)_b x_i(ω)_c t_i(k)t_i(l),

for every b,c,k,l in I. On the second branch, every entry is zero. Equality at the truncation threshold is included in the first branch.

Then both of the following assertions hold:

1. For every i in J, the matrix-valued function ω ↦ Y_i(ω)Y_i(ω) is Bochner integrable with respect to μ. More explicitly, it is almost everywhere strongly measurable and its operator norm has finite integral. The product is ordinary matrix multiplication, so this is the integrability of the matrix square, not of the entrywise square.
2. With Id denoting the identity matrix on the paired index set I × I, the matrix

       C Id − Σ_{i=0}^{d−1} ∫_Ω Y_i(ω)Y_i(ω) dμ(ω)

   is symmetric positive semidefinite. Equivalently,

       Σ_{i=0}^{d−1} ∫_Ω Y_i(ω)^2 dμ(ω) ≼ [2(q+1)(q+3)/d] Id,

   where ≼ is the positive-semidefinite order on real matrices: the difference on the right minus the left is symmetric and has nonnegative quadratic form on every vector in R^(I × I). All matrix integrals in these assertions are Bochner integrals in the complete Euclidean operator norm.

# Seven-slot analysis

## 1. objects

The fixed objects are D = R^d, E = R^(q+1), the sample space Ω = {0,...,q} → D, the finite product standard Gaussian measure μ, the real scalar r = q+1, the real scalars L and C, angles θ_i, deterministic cosine vectors t_i, coordinate-row random vectors x_i, and random real matrices Y_i indexed in both directions by {0,...,q} × {0,...,q}. The vector x_i is precisely the Euclidean vector with coordinates ω(b)_i; the WithLp wrappers do not change those coordinates. The outer products and Kronecker product have the paired-index ordering stated in the reconstructed theorem.

## 2. domains

The parameters d and q are natural numbers, including zero before the hypothesis is imposed. The hypothesis forces d ≥ 2q+2; q = 0 is allowed. Coordinate indices i range from 0 through d−1. Indices b,c,k,l range from 0 through q, including both endpoints. Samples ω belong to Ω. The vectors x_i and t_i lie in E; Y_i has (q+1)^2 rows and columns and real entries. All scalar formulas use the usual embedding of natural numbers into R. Euclidean norms are used for vectors, and the complete Euclidean operator norm is used for matrix Bochner integrability.

## 3. quantifiers

For every pair of natural numbers d and q satisfying 2q+1 < d, form all displayed objects by their fixed definitions. The first conclusion holds for every i in {0,...,d−1}. The second conclusion concerns the finite sum over that same entire index set. Positive semidefiniteness includes symmetry and the nonnegative quadratic-form condition for every real vector indexed by {0,...,q} × {0,...,q}. No constant, truncation level, angle, or vector is existentially chosen.

## 4. assumptions

The sole mathematical hypothesis on the parameters is the strict inequality 2q+1 < d. The Gaussian law, product sample measure, cosine vectors, truncation level, and matrices are definitions, not additional hypotheses. Integrability is an asserted output. The condition ||x_i(ω)||_2^2 ≤ L is the branch condition defining Y_i at each sample, including equality; it is not an assumption that samples satisfy that condition.

## 5. conclusion

For each i, the matrix-valued function ω ↦ Y_i(ω)Y_i(ω), with ordinary matrix multiplication, is Bochner integrable against μ: it is almost everywhere strongly measurable and the integral of its operator norm is finite. In addition, C times the identity matrix minus the sum over all i of the Bochner integrals of Y_i(ω)Y_i(ω) is a real symmetric positive semidefinite matrix. Equivalently, the sum of these matrix second moments is at most C times the identity in the positive-semidefinite order. This is a deterministic order statement about integrated matrix squares, not a pointwise or probability bound. The explicit integrability assertion ensures these are integrable Bochner integrals rather than reliance on totalized nonintegrable integrals.

## 6. scopes

The universal parameter quantifiers and their strict dimension hypothesis enclose every local definition and both conjuncts of the conclusion. One common Ω and μ is used for all i. The angles and cosine vectors are deterministic; x_i and Y_i depend on ω. The truncation branch applies separately to each i and ω, using the squared norm of that row, with the zero matrix on the complementary event ||x_i(ω)||_2^2 > L. In the second conclusion, each product Y_i(ω)Y_i(ω) is integrated before the finite sum is taken. The identity has the paired index set {0,...,q} × {0,...,q}. No almost-sure qualifier weakens the resulting deterministic matrix order assertion.

## 7. constant_dependencies

The scalar r = q+1 depends only on q. The truncation level is exactly L = 2r + 3 log(1000d), with natural logarithm, and depends only on d and q. The bound is exactly C = 2r(r+2)/d, depending only on d and q. The numbers 2, 3, and 1000, the factor sqrt(2), the half-grid shift 1/2, and π are fixed constants. The angles θ_i depend only on i and d; the cosine coordinate t_i(k) is fixed by i,k,d, with k ranging through 0,...,q. No scalar constant depends on ω or is left unspecified.

theorem actual_source_truncated_matrix_second_moments
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let C : ℝ := 2 * r * (r + 2) / (d : ℝ)
  (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y i ω) μ) ∧
    Matrix.PosSemidef
      (C • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) -
        ∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ)
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let C : ℝ := 2 * r * (r + 2) / (d : ℝ)

  let ν : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let G : E → M := fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let weighted : E → M := fun x => R x • G x
  let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let S : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2
  let K : Fin d → N := fun i => Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (feature i)
  let α : ℝ := (r + 2) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
  let B : N := α • (∑ i : Fin d, S i • K i)
  let good : Fin d → Set Ω := fun i => {ω | ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
  let squared : Fin d → Ω → N := fun i ω => Y i ω * Y i ω
  let c : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => S i / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
  let tensor : Fin d → M →ₗ[ℝ] N := fun i =>
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N).flip (feature i)
  let scaled : Fin d → M →L[ℝ] N := fun i => c i • (tensor i).toContinuousLinearMap
  let W : Fin d → Ω → N := fun i ω => scaled i (weighted (row i ω))

  -- Canonical fourth moment, transported by the actual physical row map.
  have moment := FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment.actual_radial_fourth_moment_matrix
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change Integrable weighted ν ∧ (∫ x, weighted x ∂ν) = (r + 2) • (1 : M) at moment
  have row_law (i : Fin d) : MeasurePreserving (row i) μ ν :=
    FixedSpectrumSourceRowLaw.actual_source_row_marginal_law hq i
  have actual_weighted_integrable (i : Fin d) :
      Integrable (fun ω => weighted (row i ω)) μ :=
    (row_law i).integrable_comp_of_integrable moment.1
  have actual_weighted_mean (i : Fin d) :
      (∫ ω, weighted (row i ω) ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : M) := by
    have measurable_on_map : AEStronglyMeasurable weighted (Measure.map (row i) μ) := by
      rw [(row_law i).map_eq]
      exact moment.1.aestronglyMeasurable
    have transport := integral_map (row_law i).measurable.aemeasurable measurable_on_map
    rw [(row_law i).map_eq] at transport
    exact transport.symm.trans moment.2
  have W_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (W i) μ :=
    (scaled i).integrable_comp (actual_weighted_integrable i)
  have good_measurable (i : Fin d) : MeasurableSet (good i) := by
    dsimp only [good]
    exact measurableSet_le ((row_law i).measurable.norm.pow_const 2) measurable_const

  -- Both ordinary rank-one squares, retaining the actual row's own cutoff.
  have rank_square (v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
      Matrix.vecMulVec v v * Matrix.vecMulVec v v =
        (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (v k) ^ 2) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]
    congr 1
    simp [dotProduct, pow_two]
  have gram_square (x : E) : G x * G x = R x • G x := by
    have h := rank_square (WithLp.ofLp x)
    have radius_sum : (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (x k) ^ 2) = R x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq x).symm
    simpa only [radius_sum] using h
  have feature_square (i : Fin d) : feature i * feature i = S i • feature i :=
    rank_square (t i)
  have squared_as_indicator (i : Fin d) : squared i = (good i).indicator (W i) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ good i
    · have hcut : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L := hω
      simp only [squared, Y, if_pos hcut, Set.indicator_of_mem hω]
      change ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G (row i ω)) (feature i)) *
        ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G (row i ω)) (feature i)) =
          c i • Matrix.kronecker (R (row i ω) • G (row i ω)) (feature i)
      dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
        gram_square (row i ω), feature_square i]
      ext a b
      change (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((R (row i ω) * G (row i ω) a.1 b.1) * (S i * feature i a.2 b.2))) =
          c i * ((R (row i ω) * G (row i ω) a.1 b.1) * feature i a.2 b.2)
      dsimp [c]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    · have hcut : ¬ ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L := hω
      simp [squared, Y, hcut, Set.indicator_of_notMem hω]
  have squared_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (squared i) μ := by
    rw [squared_as_indicator i]
    exact (W_integrable i).indicator (good_measurable i)

  -- The actual untruncated majorant is a nonnegative rank-one matrix.
  have W_positive (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (W i ω).PosSemidef := by
    let x := row i ω
    let v : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun a => x a.1 * t i a.2
    have rank_positive : (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v
    have W_rank : W i ω = (c i * R x) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
      ext a b
      change c i * (R x * (x a.1 * x b.1) * (t i a.2 * t i b.2)) =
        (c i * R x) * ((x a.1 * t i a.2) * (x b.1 * t i b.2))
      ring
    rw [W_rank]
    exact rank_positive.smul (mul_nonneg
      (div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _))
      (sq_nonneg ‖x‖))
  have residual_positive (ω : Ω) :
      ((∑ i : Fin d, W i ω) - ∑ i : Fin d, squared i ω).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ
    intro i _
    rw [squared_as_indicator i]
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ good i
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem hω] using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero : (0 : N).PosSemidef)
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω] using W_positive i ω
  have W_sum_integrable : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d, W i ω) μ :=
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => W_integrable i)
  have squared_sum_integrable : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d, squared i ω) μ :=
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => squared_integrable i)

theorem actual_source_truncated_matrix_second_moments
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let C : ℝ := 2 * r * (r + 2) / (d : ℝ)
  (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y i ω) μ) ∧
    Matrix.PosSemidef
      (C • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) -
        ∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ)
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let C : ℝ := 2 * r * (r + 2) / (d : ℝ)

  let ν : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let G : E → M := fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let weighted : E → M := fun x => R x • G x
  let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let S : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2
  let K : Fin d → N := fun i => Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (feature i)
  let α : ℝ := (r + 2) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
  let B : N := α • (∑ i : Fin d, S i • K i)
  let good : Fin d → Set Ω := fun i => {ω | ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
  let squared : Fin d → Ω → N := fun i ω => Y i ω * Y i ω
  let c : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => S i / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
  let tensor : Fin d → M →ₗ[ℝ] N := fun i =>
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N).flip (feature i)
  let scaled : Fin d → M →L[ℝ] N := fun i => c i • (tensor i).toContinuousLinearMap
  let W : Fin d → Ω → N := fun i ω => scaled i (weighted (row i ω))

  -- Canonical fourth moment, transported by the actual physical row map.
  have moment := FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment.actual_radial_fourth_moment_matrix
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change Integrable weighted ν ∧ (∫ x, weighted x ∂ν) = (r + 2) • (1 : M) at moment
  have row_law (i : Fin d) : MeasurePreserving (row i) μ ν :=
    FixedSpectrumSourceRowLaw.actual_source_row_marginal_law hq i
  have actual_weighted_integrable (i : Fin d) :
      Integrable (fun ω => weighted (row i ω)) μ :=
    (row_law i).integrable_comp_of_integrable moment.1
  have actual_weighted_mean (i : Fin d) :
      (∫ ω, weighted (row i ω) ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : M) := by
    have measurable_on_map : AEStronglyMeasurable weighted (Measure.map (row i) μ) := by
      rw [(row_law i).map_eq]
      exact moment.1.aestronglyMeasurable
    have transport := integral_map (row_law i).measurable.aemeasurable measurable_on_map
    rw [(row_law i).map_eq] at transport
    exact transport.symm.trans moment.2
  have W_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (W i) μ :=
    (scaled i).integrable_comp (actual_weighted_integrable i)
  have good_measurable (i : Fin d) : MeasurableSet (good i) := by
    dsimp only [good]
    exact measurableSet_le ((row_law i).measurable.norm.pow_const 2) measurable_const

      Matrix.vecMulVec v v * Matrix.vecMulVec v v =
        (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (v k) ^ 2) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]
    congr 1
    simp [dotProduct, pow_two]
  have gram_square (x : E) : G x * G x = R x • G x := by
    have h := rank_square (WithLp.ofLp x)
    have radius_sum : (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (x k) ^ 2) = R x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq x).symm
    simpa only [radius_sum] using h
  have feature_square (i : Fin d) : feature i * feature i = S i • feature i :=
    rank_square (t i)
  have squared_as_indicator (i : Fin d) : squared i = (good i).indicator (W i) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ good i
    · have hcut : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L := hω
      simp only [squared, Y, if_pos hcut, Set.indicator_of_mem hω]
      change ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G (row i ω)) (feature i)) *
        ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G (row i ω)) (feature i)) =
          c i • Matrix.kronecker (R (row i ω) • G (row i ω)) (feature i)
      dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
        gram_square (row i ω), feature_square i]
      ext a b
      change (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((R (row i ω) * G (row i ω) a.1 b.1) * (S i * feature i a.2 b.2))) =
          c i * ((R (row i ω) * G (row i ω) a.1 b.1) * feature i a.2 b.2)
      dsimp [c]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    · have hcut : ¬ ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L := hω
      simp [squared, Y, hcut, Set.indicator_of_notMem hω]
  have squared_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (squared i) μ := by
    rw [squared_as_indicator i]

  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let C : ℝ := 2 * r * (r + 2) / (d : ℝ)

  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  have raw := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixVariance.actual_source_truncated_matrix_second_moments hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y i ω) μ) ∧
    (C • (1 : N) - ∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ).PosSemidef at raw
  have first := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean.actual_source_truncated_matrix_means hq
  have Y_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (Y i) μ := first.1 i
  have Y_positive (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (Y i ω).PosSemidef := by
    by_cases hc : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
    · let v : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun a => row i ω a.1 * t i a.2
      have rank_positive : (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
        simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v
      have rank_eq : Y i ω = (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
        simp only [Y, if_pos hc]
        ext a b
        change (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((row i ω a.1 * row i ω b.1) * (t i a.2 * t i b.2)) =
          (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((row i ω a.1 * t i a.2) * (row i ω b.1 * t i b.2))
        ring
      rw [rank_eq]
      exact rank_positive.smul (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
    · simpa only [Y, if_neg hc] using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero : (0 : N).PosSemidef)
  have mean_positive (i : Fin d) : (mean i).PosSemidef :=
    integral_posSemidef (Y i) (Y_integrable i) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (Y_positive i))
  have Z_hermitian (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (Z i ω).IsHermitian :=
    (Y_positive i ω).isHermitian.sub (mean_positive i).isHermitian
  have Z_square_positive (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : (Z i ω * Z i ω).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [(Z_hermitian i ω).eq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)

steps.title: Center without assuming matrices commute
steps.text: Expand the ordinary square with both cross terms Yi Mi and Mi Yi. Fixed right and left multiplication preserve actual integrability and commute separately with the Bochner integral. The probability integral of the constant Mi squared supplies the remaining term. Thus each centered square is integrable and its expectation is the uncentered second moment minus Mi squared. Integrate PSD centered squares and add the PSD sum of mean squares to the already proved uncentered comparison.
steps.formula: \mathbb E_\mu[Z_i^2]=\mathbb E_\mu[Y_i^2]-M_i^2,\qquad A_i:=\mathbb E_\mu[Z_i^2],\qquad0\preceq\sum_i A_i\preceq C I_{r^2},\quad C=\frac{2r(r+2)}d.
steps.lean:
have expansion (i : Fin d) :
      (fun ω => Z i ω * Z i ω) = fun ω =>
        ((Y i ω * Y i ω - Y i ω * mean i) - mean i * Y i ω) + mean i * mean i := by
    funext ω
    dsimp only [Z]
    noncomm_ring
  have Z_square_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω * Z i ω) μ := by
    rw [expansion]
    exact (((raw.1 i).sub ((Y_integrable i).mul_const (mean i))).sub
      ((Y_integrable i).const_mul (mean i))).add (integrable_const _)
  have centered_mean (i : Fin d) :
      (∫ ω, Z i ω * Z i ω ∂μ) = (∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ) - mean i * mean i := by
    rw [expansion]
    have hsub1 : Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y i ω - Y i ω * mean i) μ :=
      (raw.1 i).sub ((Y_integrable i).mul_const (mean i))
    have hsub2 : Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y i ω - Y i ω * mean i - mean i * Y i ω) μ :=
      hsub1.sub ((Y_integrable i).const_mul (mean i))
    rw [integral_add hsub2
      (integrable_const (mean i * mean i) : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => mean i * mean i) μ)]
    rw [integral_sub hsub1 ((Y_integrable i).const_mul (mean i))]
    rw [integral_sub (raw.1 i) ((Y_integrable i).mul_const (mean i))]
    rw [integral_mul_const_of_integrable (Y_integrable i),
      integral_const_mul_of_integrable (Y_integrable i)]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    change (((∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ) - mean i * mean i) - mean i * mean i) +
      mean i * mean i = _
    abel
  let A : Fin d → N := fun i => ∫ ω, Z i ω * Z i ω ∂μ
  have A_positive (i : Fin d) : (A i).PosSemidef :=
    integral_posSemidef _ (Z_square_integrable i)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (Z_square_positive i))
  have A_sum_positive : (∑ i : Fin d, A i).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => A_positive i)
  have mean_square_positive (i : Fin d) : (mean i * mean i).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [(mean_positive i).isHermitian.eq] using
      Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (mean i)
  have centered_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, A i) =
      (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y i ω ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin d, mean i * mean i := by
    simp only [A, centered_mean, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have A_sum_upper : (C • (1 : N) - ∑ i : Fin d, A i).PosSemidef := by
    have h := raw.2.add (Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => mean_square_positive i))
    rw [centered_sum]
    convert h using 1; abel

steps.title: Weight by the actual cosine and bound the real operator norms
steps.text: For the exact deterministic wi=cos((2q+1)theta_i), the range of cosine gives 0<=wi squared<=1. The ordinary weighted square is wi squared times Zi squared, so its actual integrability and expectation follow. The residual sum of (1-wi squared)Ai is PSD. Both expectation sums are therefore full PSD matrices bounded above by C times the identity. Real continuous functional calculus places their real spectra in [0,C] and bounds their actual Euclidean operator norms. This is the private centered/weighted consequence, separate from P public uncentered conclusion.
steps.formula: w_i=\cos((2q+1)\theta_i),\quad0\le w_i^2\le1,\quad\mathbb E_\mu[(w_i Z_i)^2]=w_i^2 A_i,\quad\left\|\sum_i A_i\right\|\le C,\quad\left\|\sum_i\mathbb E_\mu[(w_i Z_i)^2]\right\|\le C.
steps.lean:
-- Weighting uses the actual deterministic cosine, hence 0 <= w_i^2 <= 1.
  have weight_le (i : Fin d) : (w i) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hi := Real.cos_le_one (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
    have lo := Real.neg_one_le_cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
    change (Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)) ^ 2 ≤ 1
    nlinarith
  have weighted_square (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) :
      (w i • Z i ω) * (w i • Z i ω) = (w i) ^ 2 • (Z i ω * Z i ω) := by
    simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, pow_two]
  have weighted_integrable (i : Fin d) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (w i • Z i ω) * (w i • Z i ω)) μ := by
    simp_rw [weighted_square]
    exact (Z_square_integrable i).smul ((w i) ^ 2)
  have weighted_mean (i : Fin d) :
      (∫ ω, (w i • Z i ω) * (w i • Z i ω) ∂μ) = (w i) ^ 2 • A i := by
    simp_rw [weighted_square]
    exact integral_smul _ _
  have weighted_sum_positive : (∑ i : Fin d, (w i) ^ 2 • A i).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (A_positive i).smul (sq_nonneg _))
  have weighted_residual_positive :
      ((∑ i : Fin d, A i) - ∑ i : Fin d, (w i) ^ 2 • A i).PosSemidef := by
    have h := Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ
      (fun i _ => (A_positive i).smul (sub_nonneg.mpr (weight_le i)))
    convert h using 1
    simp only [sub_smul, one_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have weighted_sum_upper :
      (C • (1 : N) - ∑ i : Fin d, (w i) ^ 2 • A i).PosSemidef := by
    have h := A_sum_upper.add weighted_residual_positive
    convert h using 1; abel

  -- The real matrix operator norm follows from real CFC and full PSD order.
  have C_nonneg : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp only [C, r]
    positivity
  have real_norm_bound (B : N) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
      (hupper : (C • (1 : N) - B).PosSemidef) : ‖B‖ ≤ C := by
    have hsa : IsSelfAdjoint B := hB.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint
    have hlo : 0 ≤ B := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr hB
    have hup : B ≤ algebraMap ℝ N C := by
      apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hupper
    have slo := (StarOrderedRing.nonneg_iff_spectrum_nonneg (R := ℝ) B hsa).mp hlo
    have sup := (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le (R := ℝ) (a := B) hsa).mp hup
    have hn : ‖cfc (id : ℝ → ℝ) B‖ ≤ C := norm_cfc_le C_nonneg (by
      intro x hx
      simpa only [id_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (slo x hx)] using sup x hx)
    simpa only [cfc_id ℝ B hsa] using hn
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω * Z i ω) μ) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (fun ω => (w i • Z i ω) * (w i • Z i ω)) μ) ∧
    ‖∑ i : Fin d, A i‖ ≤ C ∧
    ‖∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, (w i • Z i ω) * (w i • Z i ω) ∂μ‖ ≤ C
  refine ⟨Z_square_integrable, weighted_integrable,
    real_norm_bound _ A_sum_positive A_sum_upper, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [weighted_mean]
  exact real_norm_bound _ weighted_sum_positive weighted_sum_upper
